sources.quote: 1. Press the eject button to open the disc tray.
Turn on the Xbox console by pressing the power button.

notes: Source: archive.org scan of Microsoft's 'XBOX Console Instruction Manual' (2001); quotes are clean lines of the scan's OCR text layer (_djvu.txt). Counts as primary (the maker's own manual).

controls: the manual's console-front figure labels exactly two controls, 'Eject button' and 'Power/reset button'. The combined power/reset button is filed once as power_button (no separate reset_button exists on the unit per this figure).
media: the console's one media interface is the disc tray ('Press the eject button to open the disc tray').

Partial facts not filed as a list: 'insert the Xbox controller connecter into any controller port on the front of the Xbox console'; 'the AV port'; 'the Ethernet port on the back'. No complete port enumeration is printed.
Envelope: none found. CHM 102662816 is a sealed boxed unit with two unlabelled dimension pairs and is not used.
